sources.title: OpenAI-Gym-CartPole-v1-REINFORCE - GitHub
sources.snippet: Repository files navigation README MIT license OpenAI-Gym-CartPole-v1-REINFORCE Implementation of REINFORCE to solve OpenAI Gym's CartPole environment. Gym EnvironmentA pole is attached by an un-actuated joint to a cart, which moves along a frictionless track. The system is controlled by applying a force of +1 or -1 to the cart.
